title: Page 185
transc:
Nashville 8.55 A. M.
Maj Eckert Wash'n  June 3d
Copy to Beckwith Gen. Grants Hd. Qr's
Empress June peach for Jacob growl zebra the
following has just been received from palsy S
P Carter violet chart June plank unity A
Hanoverian named finck who left brandy about the
gradual may states that but peach woodbury were
left sligo city pause some postpone promise left
with holland zebra soon afterwards honduras ordered plaster
purple more to join him which composed the
salem in bravo exclusive torch plank waldo zebra
finick says the city could be taken by
pebble purple spit if approached saxon waly ward
and wilson ward zodiac he left stephen morning
train for embrace zebra he saw no whiff
except a few guerrillas this side of brandy
pause he came via columbia avon take joy
D Webster palsy how is juro progressing now
J. C. Van Duzer


Fortress Monroe June 4 / 64
Maj. Eckert Wash'n.
Flag ship agawarn Farrars sidney peach via appian laura
penny for burton grapes zebra no change sligo naval
situation except that I have received here from Knave 
the vessels he had provided at blubber as part
of his plan of pearl pain for obstructing Bergen
Walrus Neptune dated peach P M but no time
Geo D. Sheldon
